hints.title: Negative Factor Sign Flip Obstacle
hints.text: Multiplying by a negative number turns a large positive product into a small negative one, but turns a small negative product into a large positive one. How can tracking both extreme bounds maintain the maximum potential?

hints.title: Simultaneous Min-Max Tracking Invariant
hints.text: At each element, the new maximum product can arise from the current number, the current number times the previous maximum, or the current number times the previous minimum.

hints.title: Dual Scalar Register Update Procedure
hints.text: Initialize global max, current max, and current min to the first element. Iterate through remaining numbers: if the number is negative, swap current max and current min. Update current max to max(num, current max * num) and current min to min(num, current min * num). Update global max. Return global max.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of elements in nums
complexity.notes: Single pass updates min and max product accumulators.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all subarray products takes O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant scalar variables eliminate table allocations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Tracking both the running minimum and running maximum to handle negative values properly.
